rules.rule: T-gates cannot pass mid-rail voltages at VDD=0.9V
rules.reason: Vth_n ~ 0.45V, NFET cuts off for Vin > VDD-Vth ~ 0.45V. PFET cuts off for Vin < |Vthp| ~ 0.55V. Dead zone 0.45-0.55V.
rules.workaround: Use bootstrapped switch, or design signals to stay below 0.4V

rules.rule: EWMA via charge sharing requires capture time >> tau_SF
rules.reason: SF output impedance = 1/gm_sf. At 50pA bias, Rout~776MOhm. tau = Rout * Csamp. For Csamp=5pF, tau=3.88ms. Need 14*tau ~ 55ms for 99.99% settling.
rules.incident: ewma-ic-propagation-fix: 0.5ms capture gave only 12% settling, effective EWMA alpha was 0.012 instead of 0.10

rules.rule: Comparator pipeline delay varies with input slope
rules.reason: Resolution time depends on overdrive at threshold crossing. Slow SF ramp = long resolution time.
rules.incident: delay-timer-calibration: single pipe_main=3.5ms failed for several comparators

rules.rule: IC propagation between simulation batches is mandatory for circuits with memory
rules.reason: EWMA caps, S&H caps, and timer caps carry state between beats. Resetting to default IC each batch destroys convergence.
rules.workaround: Use .meas to extract cap voltages at end of each batch and propagate as .ic for next batch
rules.incident: ewma-ic-propagation-fix: F1/F2 rho dropped to 0.29/-0.30 without IC propagation

rules.rule: ReRAM conductance ratio G_MAX/G_MIN = 335:1 may be too aggressive
rules.reason: Typical experimental RRAM ratios are 10:1 to 100:1. PDK documents up to 8 levels (3 bits).
rules.workaround: Verify with actual PDK specs. May need to constrain weight mapping range.

rules.rule: Bias generator requires startup circuit in silicon
rules.reason: Self-biased current mirror has stable zero-current state. .ic V(xbias.iref)=0.3 works in simulation only.
rules.workaround: Add startup circuit for tapeout. OK for simulation with .ic.

rules.rule: Hybrid mirror+diode loads give controllable moderate gain (1.7-3x)
rules.reason: Pure diode gives gain~1 (insufficient span). Pure active mirror gives gain~30 (massive clipping). Hybrid provides sweet spot.
rules.workaround: Adjust W_diode to tune gain. Smaller W_diode = higher gain. Min W=0.42um in SKY130.
rules.incident: Feature validation criteria: features failed span >= 225mV with diode-only loads

rules.rule: At VDD=0.9V with Vth~0.45V, cascode stacks are NOT feasible
rules.reason: Only headroom for one NFET + one PFET in a stack. Bias currents 10pA-1nA for <10nW power.
rules.workaround: Use single-transistor gain stages. Cascoding requires VDD >= 1.5V for this process.
